description: Calculate annual Israeli income tax on personal-exertion income from the published brackets and surtax, with a per-bracket breakdown. Approved tax years: 2024, 2025 and 2026 — 2025 repeats the 2024 brackets under the 2025–2027 indexation freeze, and 2026 widens the two middle brackets retroactively to 01.01.2026. Excludes credit points, non-personal-exertion income, the additional capital surtax (2% from 2025) and National Insurance. Unverified years are refused. Not tax advice.

annual_income.description: Annual taxable income from personal exertion (יגיעה אישית), in NIS, after deductions

tax_year.description: Tax year the income belongs to. Approved tax years: 2024, 2025 and 2026. 2025 repeats the 2024 brackets — indexation is frozen for 2025–2027 by the Economic Efficiency Law (Freezing of Tax Updates and Surtax) 5785-2024; 2026 widens the two middle brackets under the amendment to s.121 ITO, retroactive to 01.01.2026. Any other year is refused.
